name: writing_system
description: Identify Unicode writing systems from natural words: Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Hiragana, Hangul. Matched control extracts an English marker from identical records.
generator_code:
import random,json,unicodedata
random.seed(0)
groups=[['привет','мир','дом','книга','Москва','собака','река','город','школа','вода'],['κόσμος','νερό','γάτα','Αθήνα','καλημέρα','ήλιος','βιβλίο','σπίτι','πόλη','δέντρο'],['مرحبا','كتاب','بيت','قلم','شمس','ماء','مدينة','باب','قمر','مدرسة'],['שלום','ספר','בית','מים','שמש','ילד','עץ','עיר','דלת','לילה'],['こんにちは','ありがとう','ねこ','さくら','ひらがな','やま','かわ','そら','はな','いぬ'],['안녕하세요','사랑','학교','한국','서울','사람','나무','바다','하늘','음악']]
markers=['red','blue','green','black','white']
items=[];control=[]
for ws in groups:
 for word in ws:
  script=unicodedata.name(word[0]).split()[0].title()
  for style in range(2):
   marker=random.choice(markers)
   record=f'Word: {word}\nMarker: {marker}' if style==0 else f'Marker: {marker}\nWord: {word}'
   items.append({'prompt':f'Name the writing system used for the word.\n{record}\nAnswer:','answer':' '+script})
   control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the marker, not the word.\n{record}\nAnswer:','answer':' '+marker})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
